verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs cover headless automation directly: GitHub Actions automates and executes workflows in the repository with CI/CD, the REST and GraphQL APIs support scripted automation with fine-grained tokens, and GitHub CLI plus Copilot CLI provide terminal-driven, non-GUI access. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running Copilot CLI or agents non-interactively inside CI pipelines, headless token/auth setup for CI runners, and independent hands-on corroboration.
